body.lit: [When Digivolving] If DNA digivolving, you may place up to 2 level 6 cards from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards. Then, for each of this Digimon's level 6 digivolution cards, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the bottom of the deck.

label.lit: Place lvl 6 cards from trash to digivolution cards
